hooks.text: 符文可为武器和能力附加多重射击、轨道刀刃与元素爆发，并能自由混搭扩展武库
hooks.excerpt: Modify your weapons and abilities using Runes that grant devastating effects like multishot, orbital blades, elemental bursts, and more. Mix and match Runes to expand your arsenal and wreak havoc across the battlefield.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 时间、幸运、专注、力量和平衡五条路线可同路叠加，达到门槛后解锁强协同
hooks.excerpt: Choose from five distinct Paths — Time, Luck, Focus, Power, and Balance — and stack upgrades within the same path to unlock powerful synergies and become an unstoppable force of nature.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 水火气电按环境发生连锁反应，敌人还会随当前状态动态获得抗性与弱点
hooks.excerpt: Elements react with one another in powerful and unexpected ways — fire ignites, water douses, electricity surges through moisture, and more. These interactions can drastically alter the flow of battle. Meanwhile, enemies adapt to their current state, gaining new resistances and vulnerabilities on the fly.
